Speaker: Customer
Text: Hi, I got a bill for $112 for my Advair inhaler and I thought insurance covered it.

Speaker: Representative
Text: I'm sorry about that. Let me pull up your account. Can I have your date of birth?

Speaker: Customer
Text: March 12, 1984. I always go to Contoso Pharmacy, so I'm confused why this happened.

Speaker: Representative
Text: I see the claim was processed as out-of-network. Did you recently get a new insurance card?

Speaker: Customer
Text: Yes, actually, last month. I forgot to update you.

Speaker: Representative
Text: That explains it. Please upload a copy of the new card through our secure portal or fax it, and we'll reprocess the claim.

Speaker: Customer
Text: Okay, I'll send it tonight. Thanks for checking.

Speaker: Representative
Text: You're welcome. Once we have the card on file we'll reverse the out-of-network charge.
